name: image_imread_tiff
expr: A = imread(p1); A11 = double(A(1,1)); A21 = double(A(2,1)); A12 = double(A(1,2)); A44 = double(A(4,4)); szA1 = size(A,1); szA2 = size(A,2); cls = class(A); is_uint8 = strcmp(cls, 'uint8');
comment: Minimal TIFF reader baseline (cycle 90). Inlines a 4x4 uint8 grayscale TIFF (MATLAB-imwrite-uncompressed format, 122 bytes header + 16 pixels) as chunked fwrite('uint8') calls to a tempname'd file, then validates imread output. Both engines hit the same on-disk bytes. Exercises: TIFF magic detection, IFD walk, uncompressed strip decode, row-major → column-major transpose, uint8 output dtype. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b on all 7 fingerprints (tol=0 since pixel values are integers). Compression schemes (LZW / PackBits / Deflate), 16-bit RGB + multi-page TIFF deferred to later cycles.
